conventions.units: SVG root width/height are inches; viewBox is 0.01 in per user unit; anchors/landmarks are in user units, origin top-left of the artwork box.
conventions.layers: A layer (nametag, board, braid, epaulet sleeve) shares its base garment box and registers at 0,0; draw order is base garment, then layers, then insignia at the layer slots.
conventions.hats: A hat or cap asset is placed by aligning its garment_attach_center with the garment top_center (cap sits on the top edge of the artwork box).
conventions.cords: A shoulder cord is placed by its shoulder_seam_attach on the garment epaulet strap axis (centred, 0.125 in toward the neck), under the epaulet sleeve.
conventions.epaulet_sleeves: Use the garment-*-epaulet-sleeve-* layers for sleeve shape on the shirts and put grade insignia at rank_slot; rank-epaulet-sleeve-* are standalone graded sleeves (1.97 x 3.84 in) and are wider than the drawn strap.
conventions.size_source: regulation = dimension from a regulation or purchase description; measured = measured from a reference at a stated scale; estimated = assumed (see basis).
